extends: the v1, v2 and v3 research files, which are not modified
grade_policy: No feeding grade is assigned in the research layer. A record here is not a statement that the plant is safe to feed.
note: Statements made by sources that were read. They are not toxicity findings for tortoises.

statements.statement: listed among plant species eaten by leopard tortoises that are suspected to contain toxic substances; active secondary compound: cyanin
statements.compound_attribution: the table cites Watt & Breyer-Brandwijk (1962) and Pratt & Gwynne (1977), which were not read
statements.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not show that the plant harms tortoises: the same source records leopard tortoises eating it and reports no health outcome. It also does not show that the plant is safe, and it gives no measured oxalate or toxin content.
